2607.10197.title: GRATE: Temporal Extensions for Inductive KG Foundation Models via Gated Rotary Attention
2607.10197.paper_summary: Knowledge graph foundation models such as Ultra and Trix achieve strong inductive transfer by learning relation-graph representations that generalise to unseen entities and relations. Extending this transferability to temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) remains challenging: existing temporal models tie their parameters to dataset-specific entities, relations, or timestamps and are not designed to transfer to TKGs with disjoint vocabularies. We propose GRATE (Gated Rotary Attention for Temporal Encoding), an entity-side message function that adds no learnable parameters and encodes time through relative time differences by rotating each edge message according to its time gap to the query and applying a query-conditioned gate to select temporally relevant signals. GRATE integrates into NBFNet-style KG foundation models while preserving structural transferability. Existing TKG benchmarks evaluate within shared train/test vocabularies and cannot directly test cross-dataset temporal transfer; we therefore construct GDELTIndT and WIKIIndT, inductive transfer benchmark suites with disjoint entities, relations, and timestamps spanning both interpolation and extrapolation. Across these benchmarks and held-out forecasting datasets, a single jointly pretrained GRATE checkpoint improves over the static base model in most settings.
2607.10197.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜基礎模型如 Ultra 和 Trix 通過學習關係圖表示來實現強大的歸納轉移，這些表示能夠推廣到未見過的實體和關係。將這種可轉移性擴展到時間知識圖譜 (TKGs) 仍然面臨挑戰：現有的時間模型將其參數綁定到特定數據集的實體、關係或時間戳，並且並未設計為能夠轉移到具有不相交詞彙的 TKGs。我們提出了 GRATE（Gated Rotary Attention for Temporal Encoding），這是一種實體端消息函數，沒有增加可學習的參數，並通過根據每條邊的時間差旋轉每條邊的消息來編碼時間，並應用查詢條件閘來選擇時間上相關的信號。GRATE 可以整合到 NBFNet 風格的 KG 基礎模型中，同時保留結構的可轉移性。現有的 TKG 基準在共享的訓練/測試詞彙內進行評估，無法直接測試跨數據集的時間轉移；因此，我們構建了 GDELTIndT 和 WIKIIndT，這是具有不相交實體、關係和時間戳的歸納轉移基準套件，涵蓋插值和外推。在這些基準和保留的預測數據集上，單個共同預訓練的 GRATE 檢查點在大多數設置中優於靜態基模型。
